# Workspace Guidelines

Our group keeps every proposal in the `proposals/` folder so the workspace root
stays free for shared material, and expects a broader literature base.

```toml
[paths]
proposals = "proposals/"

[references]
min_count = 8
```

The proposal and everything that belongs to it — notes, harvest record, figures,
reviews, built documents — live together under `proposals/`. This file stays at
the workspace root: it is the anchor the location is measured from.
